summary: __usercall FPU-state wrapper. Saves the x87 state with fsave into a stack buffer (save area at buffer+8), calls sub_58DE2C with arguments (a2, a1) and a pointer to the buffer, then restores the x87 state with frstor. Returns the first double of the saved buffer (the st0 snapshot). If sub_58DE2C returns non-zero, calls SetByteFlag().

operations.description: Save the x87 FPU state via fsave into the local buffer (save area begins at buffer offset 8).
Call sub_58DE2C(a2, a1, (int)v6), passing both source arguments and a pointer to the FPU save buffer.
Restore the x87 FPU state via frstor from the buffer, then return v6[0], the first saved double.
If sub_58DE2C returned non-zero, invoke SetByteFlag() before returning.

unresolved: Why the FPU state is saved/restored around sub_58DE2C (reentrancy or ABI isolation) is not established.
SetByteFlag target and the meaning of the flag it raises are unknown.
Semantics of sub_58DE2C's two FPU arguments and its return flag are unknown.
